name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. It’s the strongest open MoE model available right now, delivering near-frontier performance at a fraction of the cost of dense giants. The trade-off is higher memory usage during inference, but that’s worth it for the 1-2% capability bump over DeepSeek-V3-671B-Instruct.

name: Torque
text: Adopting Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct risks worsening EXCAVA’s memory bottleneck by 15-20% due to MoE routing overhead, which directly throttles throughput—its "fraction of cost" claim ignores real-time latency spikes under load. A better alternative is DeepSeek-V3-671B: its router speed cuts inference overhead, and its 671B parameter density delivers stronger performance without the memory tax. Settle it by benchmarking both models on EXCAVA’s production workload—if DeepSeek-V3-671B hits the same or better accuracy with lower latency, it wins.
